# telnyx_phone_number_regulatory_requirements (Data Source)

The regulatory requirements that apply to specific phone numbers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# What Telnyx needs before these Swiss numbers can be used.
data "telnyx_phone_number_regulatory_requirements" "swiss" {
  filter_phone_number = "+41215470622,+41215470633"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_phone_number` (String) Record type phone number/ phone numbers
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
